name: describe_individual
description: Describe an individual in one answer: its kind and the kinds that kind specialises, the individuals holding it (which often say what it is: 'held as <field> of a <Kind>'), and each of its fields with its meaning and value, held individuals described in turn down to the depth asked. Values marked '(default)' are the field's declared default rather than a measurement. Individuals beyond the depth appear as 'see <handle>'; describe them in turn only if they matter.

handle.description: The individual's handle, exactly as a tool's answer gave it, written '<Kind>#<n>'.

depth.description: How many levels of held individuals to describe.
